subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <tuple> header (C++11).
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <tuple> header. Planned; not yet implemented in restd.

symbols.name: tuple_size
symbols.notes: Cv-qualified passthrough specialisations per LWG 2762.

symbols.name: tuple_element
symbols.notes: Recursive partial specialisations; cv-qualified passthrough per LWG 2762.

symbols.name: tuple
symbols.notes: Recursive-inheritance design with EBO for empty element types. Members: default ctor, direct-element ctor, generic forwarding ctor (SFINAE on arity match + is_constructible<_Head, _UHead&&>), converting tuple-from-tuple copy/move ctors (matching arity + per-element constructibility), pair-converting copy/move ctors restricted to 2-element tuples via sizeof...(_Tail) == 1 SFINAE (added 2026-05-17 alongside the pair-tuple interop), four assignment ops (copy/move + cross-type tuple copy/move) plus two pair-converting assignment ops, and swap. pair-converting members require pair to be complete at instantiation point — forward declared in tuple.hpp so users can opt in by including utility/pair.hpp.
symbols.failure_reason: Requires variadic templates and rvalue references (C++11+). No portable C++98/03 implementation is planned; the restd::pair already covers two-element aggregation on that tier.

symbols.name: get<I>(tuple)
symbols.notes: Index-based access. Four value-category overloads.

symbols.name: get<T>(tuple)
symbols.notes: Type-based access. SFINAE-rejected if T appears 0 or >1 times in the element pack.

symbols.name: make_tuple
symbols.notes: Decay-and-deduce factory. reference_wrapper unwrap pending restd::reference_wrapper.

symbols.name: tie
symbols.notes: Tuple of lvalue refs; pairs with the ignore object for destructuring.

symbols.name: forward_as_tuple
symbols.notes: Tuple of forwarding refs. Result must be consumed before any temporaries die.

symbols.name: tuple_cat
symbols.notes: Pair-wise reduction over an internal index_seq machinery (private until restd::utility lands).

symbols.name: apply
symbols.notes: Currently uses direct call syntax; pointer-to-member callables pending restd::invoke.

symbols.name: make_from_tuple
symbols.notes: Construct T from tuple elements as ctor args.

symbols.name: operator==
symbols.notes: Lexicographic equality across paired elements.

symbols.name: operator!=
symbols.notes: Defaulted via op== since C++20; restd ships explicit overload for portability.

symbols.name: operator<
symbols.notes: Lexicographic less-than.

symbols.name: operator<=
symbols.notes: Synthesised from op< since C++20; restd ships explicit overload.

symbols.name: operator>
symbols.notes: Synthesised from op< since C++20; restd ships explicit overload.

symbols.name: operator>=
symbols.notes: Synthesised from op< since C++20; restd ships explicit overload.

symbols.name: operator<=>
symbols.notes: Shipped 2026-05-17 in tuple/tuple_compare_three_way.hpp. Lexicographic three-way comparison with return type common_comparison_category_t over all element-wise <=> results. Recursive helper internal::tuple_3way_impl walks indices via if constexpr; the identity is strong_ordering::equal cast to the common result type. Arity-matching enforced via a `requires (sizeof...(_A) == sizeof...(_B))` clause. The standard's synth-three-way fallback (from `<` and `==` for types without <=>) is NOT implemented — element types without operator<=> cause a compile error at the decltype site (back-port simplification).

symbols.name: swap (non-member)
symbols.notes: ADL-friendly free swap delegating to the member swap.

symbols.name: ignore
symbols.notes: Sink object whose op= discards any value. For use with tie().

symbols.notes: Allocator-extended ctor overloads.
